Container.Name: tidbyt-unraid
Container.Overview: Display live Unraid server metrics on your Tidbyt device. Uses the official Unraid GraphQL API (Unraid 7.2+) and pushes directly to your Tidbyt over WiFi.
Container.Description: Display live Unraid server metrics on your Tidbyt device. Uses the official Unraid GraphQL API (Unraid 7.2+) and pushes directly to your Tidbyt over WiFi.

Config.Name: Unraid URL
Config.Description: Your Unraid server URL (e.g. https://tower.local or http://192.168.1.100)

Config.Name: Unraid API Key
Config.Description: API key from Unraid (Settings → Management Access → API Keys)

Config.Name: Tidbyt Device ID
Config.Description: Your Tidbyt device ID (from Tidbyt app)

Config.Name: Tidbyt API Key
Config.Description: Your Tidbyt API key (from Tidbyt app settings)
